input: Which 10 product categories generate the most revenue?

sql.proposed: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, round(sum(i.price), 2) AS revenue FROM olist_order_items_dataset i JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
sql.executed: SELECT "t"."product_category_name_english" AS "category", ROUND(SUM("i"."price"), 2) AS "revenue" FROM "olist_order_items_dataset" AS "i" JOIN "olist_products_dataset" AS "p" ON "i"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" JOIN "product_category_name_translation" AS "t" ON "p"."product_category_name" = "t"."product_category_name" GROUP BY "t"."product_category_name_english" ORDER BY "revenue" DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions: Revenue is the sum of item prices (freight excluded), over all order statuses.
Categories use the English names from product_category_name_translation; products without a category are left out by the inner join.
